create_gptq_quantization_config: create a GPTQConfig quantization config for 4-bit weight quantization with group size 128
create_gptq_marlin_config: create a GPTQMarlinConfig quantization config for 4-bit symmetric weight quantization with group size
build_gptq_linear_method: build a GPTQLinearMethod that creates and applies quantized linear layer weights using exllama kernel
build_gptq_marlin_linear_method: build a GPTQMarlinLinearMethod that repacks weights and applies quantized linear inference with marlin kernel
run_unpack_from_int32: run unpack_from_int32 to unpack quantized int32 weights back to original bit representation
